fix_code:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input().rstrip())
arr = list(map(int, input().rstrip().split()))

res = 0
for color in range(1, n + 1):
    indices = [i for i, x in enumerate(arr) if x == color]
    if len(indices) == 2 and indices[1] - indices[0] == 2:
        res += 1

print(res)
